Affordability is the goal of this delivery approach, not a percentage discount or guaranteed price. We use AI to assist design, coding and testing while keeping human judgement and responsibility.

The business case sets the scope

Cost

What will it cost to build and run?

Return

What will improve in your business?

Payback

When does the investment pay back?

If the value doesn't add up, we say so.

Count running and maintenance costs as well as the initial build. Choose a useful scope, and be willing to recommend against a build whose business case does not hold up.

We value European cooperation and sovereignty.
We choose partners and infrastructure to fit your requirements.

European cooperation is a value and a design choice. European hosting alone does not establish where every AI provider processes data. Provider choices and data flows must be agreed for each project.
